data.summary_en: MemTrace stores execution-history as file/symbol/test-anchored immutable Memory Traces; Memory Trace Graph orders/dependencies them; pre-restore validates vs repo state, fetching only next-step content. 3 long-horizon coding benchmarks, same backbone/harness, beats all fully-evaluated baselines: DeepSWE pass@1 +21.2 points, SWE-EVO Resolved Rate +4.4 points, SWE-Milestone Score +17.8 points.
